fake.h: Robber in a full suit of armour flees a bakery in {} on a Segway he bought in 1985
fake.tell: Segways did not exist until 2001, so nobody could have bought one in 1985.

fake.h: Postman, 24, in an Elvis wig admits hoarding 31 years of undelivered letters in a shed in {}
fake.tell: A 24-year-old cannot have hoarded letters for 31 years.

fake.h: Burglar in a gorilla suit steals 48 wheels of sheep's-milk Parmesan from a deli in {}
fake.tell: Parmesan is made from cow's milk, not sheep's milk.

fake.h: Thief in a lifeguard costume steals 12 bicycles in {}, then sells 15 of them online
fake.tell: He cannot sell more bicycles than he stole.

fake.h: Guide in {} in a polar-bear suit sells 74 tourists an Antarctic cruise to spot wild polar bears
fake.tell: Polar bears live in the Arctic; there are none in Antarctica.

fake.h: Collector in a toga donates a Roman coin stamped '44 AD' to a museum in {}, which displays it
fake.tell: Romans never dated coins AD; that system came centuries later.

fake.h: Pub in {} gives free pints for life to 17 regulars born on 29 February 1990
fake.tell: 1990 was not a leap year, so nobody was born on 29 February 1990.

fake.h: Farmer, 63, digging a ditch in {} finds a T. rex tooth beside an 8,740-year-old hearth
fake.tell: T. rex died out about 66 million years before any human hearth.

fake.h: Burglar in a lobster costume is traced in {} after uploading his break-in to YouTube in 2003
fake.tell: YouTube was not founded until 2005, so no one could upload a video there in 2003.

fake.h: Thief in plate armour flees a 1987 bakery robbery in {} on a Segway, crashing into a fountain
fake.tell: The Segway was not launched until 2001, so a thief could not ride one in 1987.

fake.h: Suspect in a bear costume is cleared in {} of theft as his twin has identical fingerprints
fake.tell: Even identical twins have different fingerprints.

fake.h: Daredevil in a tuxedo rides a Ferris wheel in {} for 19 days, logging 4,310 35-minute laps
fake.tell: 19 days is 27,360 minutes, which fits about 781 laps of 35 minutes, not 4,310.

fake.h: Couple in beekeeper suits marry in {} on 29 February 2023, citing leap-year tradition
fake.tell: 2023 was not a leap year, so 29 February 2023 does not exist.

fake.h: Collector in a powdered wig pays £22,400 in {} for an 1810 photograph of the harbour
fake.tell: Photography was not invented until the 1820s, so no photograph from 1810 can exist.

fake.h: Hiker in a Santa suit is saved in {} after rescuers warm his core with 3 shots of whisky
fake.tell: Alcohol widens blood vessels and speeds up heat loss, so it does not warm the body's core.

fake.h: Tourist in a Roman toga tries to pay for 6 kebabs in {} with euro banknotes printed in 1996
fake.tell: Euro banknotes were first printed in 1999 and entered circulation in 2002, so none exist from 1996.

fake.h: Postman, 61, retires in {} after delivering mail on a unicycle for 52 years
fake.tell: At 61, he would have started at age 9, far too young for a postal job.

fake.h: Sailor in a tutu survives 12 days adrift off {} by drinking 2 litres of seawater a day
fake.tell: Seawater is saltier than blood, so drinking it dehydrates you faster and can kill you.

fake.h: Chocolatier in {} sells milk chocolate made to a 1450 Aztec recipe
fake.tell: Aztecs had no dairy animals, and milk chocolate was not invented until the 1870s.

fake.h: Dealer in {} sells a ballpoint pen 'signed by Napoleon' to a retired dentist for 4,310 euros
fake.tell: Napoleon died in 1821; ballpoint pens weren't invented until the late 1930s.

fake.h: Smuggler in {} is caught with 3.4 kilos of caviar from male sturgeon hidden in a cello case
fake.tell: Caviar is roe, so it can only come from female sturgeon.

fake.h: Shoplifter, 34, in {} admits stealing 1,213 tuna tins over 33 years, hidden in a trombone case
fake.tell: A 34-year-old who has stolen for 33 years began at age one.

fake.h: Promoter in {} sells 642 tickets to watch a total solar eclipse at midnight from a rooftop
fake.tell: A solar eclipse needs the Sun in the sky, so it cannot happen at midnight.

fake.h: Collector in {} pays 7,300 euros for a 1979 laptop still running its original Windows 95
fake.tell: Windows 95 arrived sixteen years after 1979, and laptops barely existed then.

fake.h: Bakery in {} sells 'gluten-free' baguettes made from wheat for 9 weeks before anyone notices
fake.tell: Wheat flour contains gluten, so a wheat baguette can't be gluten-free.

fake.h: Burglar in {} who stole 48 organ pipes says he was at a wedding on 29 February 2023
fake.tell: 2023 was not a leap year, so there was no 29 February.

fake.h: Rider in {} says he cycled 383 km in 54 minutes to deliver a still-warm pizza
fake.tell: That would mean about 425 km/h, far beyond any cyclist.

fake.h: Burglar in {} is caught after posting footage of his break-in from an iPhone stolen in 2005
fake.tell: The first iPhone wasn't released until 2007, so none could be stolen in 2005.

fake.h: Metal detectorist, 67, in {} digs up a Roman coin stamped AD 140 under his potato patch
fake.tell: The AD dating system was devised centuries after Roman times, so no coin could carry it.

fake.h: Funeral director in {} says a client's fingernails grew 9 cm in the casket after death
fake.tell: Nails and hair don't keep growing after death; the skin just retracts.

fake.h: Cyclist, 36, in {} rides 1,350 km to his wedding in 9 hours, towing a sofa as a gift
fake.tell: 1,350 km in 9 hours is an average of 150 km/h, impossible on a bicycle.

fake.h: Auction buyer, 63, in {} pays €8,350 for a menu from the Titanic's last dinner, dated 1921
fake.tell: The Titanic sank in 1912, so a menu from its last dinner can't be dated 1921.
